published_ranges._ams: AMS compatibility not stated by JAYO; 95A TPU is generally fed from an external spool rather than the AMS.
published_ranges._notes: Official listing (shared TPU/ASA page, 0.5 kg / 1 kg spools): recommended nozzle 210-230C, heated bed 70-80C; stretches up to 3x. ASA on the same listing has no published settings.

conflicts: Same official listing's title states dimensional accuracy +/-0.03 mm (body says +/-0.02 mm)
